decisions: Script: CYRILLIC. Kazakhstan has no adopted Latin alphabet or deadline (Ministry statement, 8 Sep 2026) and Wolt, Kaspi and Yandex Eda all publish Kazakh in Cyrillic. Revisit only if a Latin alphabet is legally adopted.
Food-truck word: “фудтрак” (pl. фудтрактар, dative фудтрактарға) borrowed via Russian; Low confidence — no Kazakh-language food-truck page was found; a native check is advised.
Order button: no statutory wording in Kazakhstan’s consumer law; market norm “Тапсырысты рәсімдеу” / “Тапсырыс беру”; card variant “{amount} төлеу”.
Pay at Hatch: recommend “Фудтракта төлеу” (feature) / “Орнында төлеу” (button). Avoid “алған кезде төлеу”, “курьерге төлеу” (cash-on-delivery sense).
Kazakh ads/visual information are commonly published in both Kazakh and Russian in Kazakhstan; offering kk-KZ alongside ru-KZ matches what Kaspi and Wolt do (ҚазРус switch).
